instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a sunny outdoor park filled with green trees, the woman with curly dark hair (R1) and the man with long brown hair and sunglasses (R2) walk side-by-side. On the left, the woman wearing a dark blue shirt with a black panel walks forward, looking towards him with a warm smile. On the right, the man in a blue and white plaid shirt walks alongside her, looking slightly to his right. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the leafy canopy, casting warm light and soft shadows across the path.
